notes: Run plan's goal and distance cards (owner, 2026-11-13, choosing prototype (i)): one photograph per card, cut small (640 x 356 WebP) because a card is about 176 px wide. Four reuse photographs the app already licenses (a Space cover, a welcome photograph); three are new Unsplash+ downloads (the Half, the Marathon and the race card before a race is chosen). 'Training for a race' shows the chosen race's own Space cover instead once the goal is bound to a race.
